_about: Public-domain George Herbert Morrison (1866-1928), minister of Wellington Church, Glasgow, for the Word Hoard: his volumes of Sunday-evening addresses from Sun-Rise (1903) to Highways of the Heart (1926), with The Footsteps of the Flock and The Significance of the Cross. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 72 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

morrison-sun-rise: Sun-rise : addresses from a city pulpit (New York : Hodder and Stoughton, 1903)
morrison-footsteps-of-flock: The footsteps of the flock : scripture studies for every Sunday of the year (London : Hodder and Stoughton, 1904)
morrison-wings-of-morning: The wings of the morning : addresses from a Glasgow pulpit (A.C. Armstrong and Son, 1907)
morrison-return-of-angels: The return of the angels : Sunday evenings in a Glasgow pulpit (London : Hodder and Stoughton, 1909)
morrison-flood-tide: Flood-tide : Sunday evenings in a city pulpit (London : Hodder and Stoughton, 1910)
morrison-unlighted-lustre: The Unlighted Lustre: addresses from a Glasgow pulpit (New York and London: Hodder and Stoughton; undated, catalogued as 191-)
morrison-afterglow-of-god: The Afterglow of God: Sunday evenings in a Glasgow pulpit (London: Hodder and Stoughton, 1912)
morrison-weaving-of-glory: The weaving of glory : Sunday evening addresses from a city pulpit (London : Hodder & Stoughton, 1913)
morrison-wind-on-the-heath: The wind on the heath : Sunday evening addresses from a Glasgow pulpit (London : Hodder and Soughton, 1916)
morrison-significance-of-cross: The significance of the cross : a New Testament study (New York : George H. Doran, 1924)
morrison-highways-of-heart: Highways of the heart : a series of addresses (New York : Doran, 1926)
